question: Related Questions Q. Ayat Al Kursi after fardh salah 2877 views Q. ALLAH HAAFIZ JAVED M.ALI SIDDIQUE 2005 views Q. Dear Muftisab, Assalaumaikum, I was doing a business and have lost the same and huge amount of money. I have also huge bank loans which is very difficult for me to pay. There is also one building which is uncomplete and I want to complete and give it on rent. I have also done some court cases against tenants and lost the same. I want some wazifa so that the I can complete the bank loans (2) I can get my business back (3) My building will be completed and I can get a good tenant for income. (4_) I can win the court case and eject the tenant. Regards! 3086 views Q. Dear Mufti Shahib, Assalamulaikum. I am a student of Chartered Accountancy. I obtained part 1 qualification and joined in a job in 11 years before. Since, my family was not that much financially solvent, i ought to contribute to my family. Resultantly my study discontinued. Alhamdulliah, now I decided to continue my study and decided to appear again.Due to my long gap, now i m facing the probs in consistency and dedication to study.I feel so much drowsy and tiredness while study. Therefore, i would like have your dua and kind advise for getting rid of this problem so as to appear the exam with well prepared. Kindly pray for me. Yours faithfully, Imrooz NB- my exam is due by next June 6, 2008. 1643 views
answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 42651 Country: India Title: cure of jinn and black magic Question: Actually my brother is suffering from jinn like thing. We have consulted many Amils and spend many lakhs of rupees but nothing happened. Now we are severely suffering from this problem. Every Amil says that this is due to black magic. Many said that this is sifli ilm done by non-Muslims and it is powerful it cannot be cured. Please Maulana, I want to ask whether there is no cure for these things in Islam as we do not want to go to non-Muslims for cure. If there is really cure were should we go for this? We went to more than a dozen Ulama and Amils but nothing is happening. Please guide us, we are in big trouble. Hope you will be guiding us. Answer ID: 42651 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 103/103/M=1434) May Almighty Allah remove your problems! Contact any expert and pious Amil and do the following practice: After Maghrib or Isha salah all the family members should sit together and recite the last two surahs (Surah al-Falaq and Surah al-Nas), it shall benefit, in-shaAllah. All the family members should offer salah regularly. If you have TV at home, remove it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
